name: in war
description: 1 = open armed conflict between the two states at any time during the year, declared or not (e.g. Russia-Ukraine from 2014).

name: in hybrid war
description: 1 = sustained hostile actions below open war between the two states at any time during the year (sabotage, major cyberattacks, weaponised migration, disinformation campaigns).

name: neighbours
description: 1 = the two states share a land border in that year.
